en.headline: Hong Kong records hottest Frost solar term on record at 32.1 degrees
en.dek: The Observatory said the temperature at its headquarters reached 32.1 Celsius by 2.30pm on Friday, breaking the previous mark for the traditional calendar period.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory recorded a temperature of 32.1 degrees Celsius at its Tsim Sha Tsui headquarters by 2.30pm on Friday, the highest ever measured during the Frost solar term since records began in 1884.

Frost is the 18th of the 24 solar terms in the traditional Chinese lunisolar calendar and began on 23 October this year. It traditionally marks the onset of cooler weather and the possibility of frost in northern regions, though Hong Kong remains warm.

Other parts of the city also saw high temperatures, with Sheung Shui reaching 33.7 degrees and several districts topping 33. The Observatory has forecast mainly fine, hot and very dry conditions over the weekend, with a wide day-night temperature gap.

zh.headline: 本港錄得有紀錄以來最熱霜降 天文台總部下午達32.1度
zh.dek: 天文台表示，周五下午2時半總部氣溫達32.1度，打破該節氣的歷史最高紀錄。
body: 香港天文台周五下午2時半在尖沙咀總部錄得氣溫32.1度，是自1884年有紀錄以來霜降期間的最高氣溫。
霜降是傳統二十四節氣中的第十八個，今年於10月23日開始。這個節氣在傳統上標誌天氣轉涼及北方可能出現霜，但本港仍維持溫暖。
其他地區亦錄得高溫，上水達33.7度，多區超過33度。天文台預測周末大致天晴、日間炎熱及非常乾燥，日夜溫差頗大。
